name: chat-post
title: Chat Post
description: Render one chat message with an author, text, optional code and a resource link.
usage: <ChatPostBody post={{ id: "release", author: "Sam", initials: "S", time: "10:00", text: "v2.0" }} />
useCases: In a support log, a reader sees a single message with its author, time and code snippet, even on a page without a reply editor.
In a course feed, an instructor shares a workbook link. The card shows the resource below the text, and the app adds reactions through children.
task: Render one message in your own feed or discussion.
behavior: Pass post with the author, time and text. The optional code and resource fields show a code sample and a link. Supply actions or reactions below the message using children.
